Tara Nguyen: FYI 1 -- we published a concise OKR + self-review template + manager cheat sheet for the upcoming cycle. Single-page, examples for ICs/managers, and an optional rubric. Internal link: https://redwood.docs.internal/people/okr-onepager-2026 (do not share externally). Please review with your teams this week.
Felix Moreno: thanks! Quick q: should engineers include uptime/reliability as KR metrics or is product-owned?
Tara Nguyen: Both OK. If you contribute to reliability, add a measurable proxy (error budget consumed, P99 latency change, number of postmortems avoided). If product owns the metric, align to a delivery or adoption KR.
Maya Li: For self-reviews, do we require manager sign-off before submission?
Tara Nguyen: No 1 employees submit their self-review; managers then add comments. We ask managers to complete calibration notes within two weeks.
Jordi Alvarez: Any template wording suggestions for soft goals like "improve collaboration"?
Tara Nguyen: We recommend 1) pick a proxy (meeting cadence, number of docs, stakeholder NPS), 2) set a target and timeline, 3) add evidence links. Example in doc: "Establish weekly API sync and publish 3 cross-team docs; target stakeholder satisfaction >=4/5."
Felix Moreno: Will there be a short workshop on writing measurable KRs?
PeopleOps-bot: Workshop scheduled: 2026-03-25 14:00 UTC 1 "Writing measurable KRs" (45 min). Calendar invite sent to channel.
Maya Li: Can we attach dashboards and PRs to the self-review form?
Tara Nguyen: Yes 1 there are fields for evidence links (PRs, runbooks, dashboards). Encourage screenshots + short context lines.
Jordi Alvarez: How will calibration work for managers who span multiple teams?
Tara Nguyen: Managers should join a single calibration pool per level. People Ops will send anonymized examples and a one-page rubric. Bring 3 writeups to the session.
Felix Moreno: One small ask 1 can People Ops add a short checklist for managers to run prep 1:1s?
Tara Nguyen: Adding a 6-item manager checklist: prep examples, identify cross-team anchors, flag potential outliers, draft talking points, confirm evidence links, and upload final calibration notes. Will update doc today.
Maya Li: Awesome, thanks Tara.
Tara Nguyen: Thanks all 1 please DM or open a PR on the doc if you have wording tweaks. :raised_hands:
